title: Experience Center custom dashboards: data sources, templates, sharing roles, delete and PDF export

prose.text: {{what-it-is}} {{data-sources}} ZIA's own dashboard customization is a different feature, held in [[zia.insights.dashboards]]. The pages do not state limits on dashboards, widgets or share recipients, say whether shared viewers see data their own role would hide, or define the Operational data source {{gap:limits-and-scope}}.

what-it-is.statement: Besides the preconfigured dashboards, admins can create custom dashboards (Analytics > Custom Dashboards) focused on the metrics most important to them, viewing real-time data and sharing the dashboards with others in the organization in similar or related job functions.

quotes: In addition to a robust set of preconfigured dashboards
you can also create customized dashboards so you can focus on the metrics most important to you
View real-time data so that you can detect security issues early and take action when necessary.
Collaborate and share dashboards with others in your organization in similar or related job functions.
On the Custom Dashboards page (Analytics> Custom Dashboards), you can do the following:

data-sources.statement: A custom dashboard's data source types correspond to the categories of analytics dashboards (Networking, Cybersecurity, Risk360, Digital Experience, Data Security and Operational), and a custom dashboard can contain widgets from multiple data sources.

quotes: Data Source: The data source types for the widgets on the dashboard, which correspond to the categories of analytics dashboards (i.e., Networking, Cybersecurity, Risk360, Digital Experience, Data Security, and Operational).
Custom dashboards can contain widgets from multiple data sources.

list-page.statement: The list shows the dashboards the admin created and those shared with them; among its filters are Last Modified, Created On (Last 1 Day to Last 90 Days) and Created By, and it searches by part of the name or description, and its Name and Action (share, rename, duplicate, delete) columns cannot be hidden; Shared With gives the number of users the dashboard is shared with.

quotes: The list of custom dashboards that you created and that have been shared with you.
Last Modified: Select a time range between Last 1 Day or Last 90 Days, or select Custom and use the calendar to specify a different time range.
Created On: Select a time range between Last 1 Day or Last 90 Days
Created By: Select one or more users who have created dashboards you want in the list.
Enter text that matches part of the name or description of a custom dashboard to display it in the list
Name: The name of the custom dashboard. This column cannot be hidden.
Shared With: The number of users the dashboard is shared with.
Action: Actions (share, rename, duplicate, or delete) you can take for this dashboard. This column cannot be hidden.

create.statement: A dashboard can be created from scratch or from templates Zscaler provides: the admin chooses a data source template (such as Cybersecurity or Networking) with preloaded widgets that can be modified or removed, or Blank Dashboard; widgets can be moved, resized and relocated and the time range adjusted, and the dashboard is named and described through the Actions icon's Rename.

quotes: You can create a dashboard completely from scratch, or use and combine templates provided by Zscaler.

choose a data source template (such as Cybersecurity or Networking) to start your custom dashboard with preloaded widgets that you can modify or remove, or choose Blank Dashboard to create a dashboard entirely from scratch
Your custom dashboard can contain widgets from multiple data sources.
You can move, resize, and relocate widgets as needed and adjust the time range for the data shown.
To name and describe the dashboard, click the Actions icon () in the upper right and select Rename.

edit-and-export.statement: A dashboard opens in edit mode; it can be exported to a PDF that Zscaler downloads to the admin's computer, widgets are added from the widget library, and for many widgets the Time Range icon selects a preset or custom range.

quotes: The dashboard opens in edit mode.
Export it to a PDF.
Zscaler downloads a PDF of the dashboard to your computer.
Select a widget from the widget library.
For many widgets, you can click the Time Range icon and select a preset time range, or choose a custom range.

delete.statement: Only dashboards the admin created can be deleted, and the deletion is confirmed by typing CONFIRM in the dialog box.

quotes: You can only delete dashboards that you have created.
confirm the deletion by typing CONFIRM in the dialog box.

sharing.statement: A dashboard is shared with people in the organization as Viewer (can view but not edit) or Editor (can edit the widgets and layout); for either access type the users cannot delete it, access can be changed or removed with Remove Access, and Copy Link copies the dashboard's direct link.

quotes: Add People: Enter others in your organization who can access the dashboard.
Viewer: User can view the dashboard, but cannot edit it.
Editor: User can edit the widgets and layout of the dashboard.
For either access type, users you share the dashboard with cannot delete it.
You can change their access or select Remove Access.
(Optional) Click Copy Link to copy the direct link to this dashboard.

limits-and-scope.title: Custom dashboard limits, viewer data scope and the Operational data source
limits-and-scope.detail: The custom dashboard pages state no limits on dashboards, widgets or share recipients, do not say whether people a dashboard is shared with see data their own role or scope would hide, and do not define the Operational data source. Other /unified pages with similar names describe Agentic SecOps Platform dashboards, not Analytics > Custom Dashboards, and are not part of this subject.
